findings: A non-debuggable testOnly measure APK AOT-compiles at speed on GrapheneOS even though dalvik.vm.usejit remains false. pm art dump reports [status=speed] [reason=cmdline] for the app package. Debuggable debugNoMinify stays capped at verify.

CTC is AVAILABLE on all 500 rows and never hits the 1500 ms standalone deadline (p50 99.8 ms, p95 152.6 ms, max 1301.3 ms). The Sep 21 grapheneos-hw-shard1-1 swipe numbers were interpreter-censored, not model quality.

CTC top-1/top-3 on this 500-row slice of swipe shard 1/3 is 81.0%/87.2%. fused_swipe is 46.6%/50.4% with the same fusion deficit seen on stock: CTC alone beats the fused union, and long/return_trip/double_letter collapse when fused (long top-1 79.6% → 10.2%).
fused_swipe p95 is 226.4 ms against the 200 ms budget, matching the stock-environment overrun (224.3 ms). Geometric still times out on 155/500 rows.
Swipe lexicon cold-start is 8.9 s AOT versus 130.3 s interpreted on the same phone.
limitations: Diagnostic only. The measure APK is not the pinned debugNoMinify APK 8b8eb864… used by stock-hw-shard0-1 and grapheneos-hw-shard1-1, so these rows cannot enter the Phase 0 matrix as-is.
500 rows of shard 1/3, not a full shard. Stock swipe evidence remains the 17,946-row shard 0/3.
Compiling the androidTest package to speed caused an ART class-loader-context abort on this device; the test APK was left at verify. The app package is speed.
releaseEligible is false. Pooled matrix evaluation still needs the low-RAM environment.
scope: Diagnostic GrapheneOS swipe measurement with a non-debuggable testOnly APK AOT-compiled at speed. Restores representative CTC latency after grapheneos-hw-shard1-1's interpreted debug APK censored swipe quality. Not a Phase 0 matrix replacement.
